camel_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost CreateHostAccount --region cn-hangzhou --ProtocolName SSH --HostAccountName accountname --PrivateKey 'LS0tLS1000000RCBSU0tLQ==' --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000' --RotationMode Self --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --HostId 1 --PassPhrase 123456 --HostShareKeyId 1 --PrivilegeType Normal --Password 123456
description_en: Creates a host account for a host managed by a Bastionhost instance. After you create the host account, Operations and Maintenance (O&M) engineers can use it to log on to the host through Bastionhost
description_zh: 在堡垒机中新建主机后，您可以为其创建相应的主机账户，即将您主机已有的账户托管至堡垒机。创建主机账户后，运维人员即可使用该账户通过堡垒机登录主机进行运维
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost create-host-account --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-id 1 --protocol-name SSH --host-account-name accountname --password 123456 --biz-private-key LS0tLS1000000RCBSU0tLQ== --pass-phrase 123456 --host-share-key-id 1 --privilege-type Normal --rotation-mode Self --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateHostAccount

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance where you want to create the host account.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain the instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要创建主机账户的主机所在堡垒机的实例ID。
可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取堡垒机实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance where you want to create the host account.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要创建主机账户的主机所在堡垒机的地域ID。

地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the host for which you want to create a host account.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html operation to obtain the host ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要创建主机账户的主机ID。

可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_id

parameters.help_en:
The protocol of the new host account.
Valid values:
SSH RDP
parameters.help_zh:
指定新建主机账户的协议名称。
取值： SSH RDP
parameters.name: protocol_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the new host account. The name can be up to 128 characters long
parameters.help_zh: 指定新建主机账户的名称，最长支持128字符
parameters.name: host_account_name

parameters.help_en: The password of the new host account
parameters.help_zh: 指定新建主机账户的密码
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en:
The private key of the new host account. The value is a Base64-encoded string.

This parameter is used only when ProtocolName is set to SSH. You do not need to set this parameter if ProtocolName is set to RDP. You can set both a password and a private key for the host account. When connecting to the asset, Bastionhost prioritizes the private key for the connection
parameters.help_zh:
指定新建主机账户的私钥，即使用Base64编码后的字符串。

主机账户协议ProtocolName为SSH时，该参数生效。ProtocolName为RDP时，无需配置该参数。支持同时为主机账户配置密码和私钥。在连接资产时，堡垒机会优先使用私钥进行连接
parameters.name: private_key

parameters.help_en:
The passphrase for the private key of the new host account.

You can set this parameter only when ProtocolName is set to SSH. You do not need to set this parameter if ProtocolName is set to RDP
parameters.help_zh:
定新建主机账户的私钥口令。

主机账户协议ProtocolName为SSH时，您可以配置该参数。ProtocolName为RDP时，无需配置该参数
parameters.name: pass_phrase

parameters.help_en: The ID of the shared key for the host
parameters.name: host_share_key_id

parameters.help_en:
The permission type of the account. If you do not set this parameter, the default value is Normal.

Privileged: privileged account

Normal: normal account

This parameter is supported only in Bastionhost V3.2.47 and later
parameters.help_zh:
账户权限类型，不填时默认为Normal
Privileged：特权账户
Normal：普通账户
仅支持V3.2.47及以上的版本使用
parameters.name: privilege_type

parameters.help_en:
The password change mode for the account. If you do not set this parameter, the default value is Self.

Privileged: Use a privileged account to change the password.

Self: Do not use a privileged account to change the password.

This parameter is supported only in Bastionhost V3.2.47 and later
parameters.help_zh:
账户改密模式，不填时默认为Self
Privileged：使用特权账户改密
Self：不使用特权账户改密
仅支持V3.2.47及以上的版本使用
parameters.name: rotation_mode
